verdict.rationale: Fastmail is an email inbox product, so asking whether that inbox also handles SMS, WhatsApp, social or live-chat channels is a fair question. The evidence covers only email (JMAP, filters, aliases, Masked Email), calendar and contacts. Nothing shows non-email customer channels arriving in the same inbox, so the axis applies but is unsupported.

support.subject: As a team-lead, the same inbox also handles adjacent customer channels — SMS, WhatsApp, social, or live chat — beside email
